article_context: 文章讨论印度高温行动计划的不足：预警阈值常未因地制宜，资金和执行也不均衡；研究者主张结合湿度、夜间温度和社区脆弱性，并把植树、住宅改造等中长期降温措施纳入计划。

article.title: 阅读 Text 3 · 印度高温行动计划需要更本地化、更长期
article.background: 文章讨论印度高温行动计划的不足：预警阈值常未因地制宜，资金和执行也不均衡；研究者主张结合湿度、夜间温度和社区脆弱性，并把植树、住宅改造等中长期降温措施纳入计划。

sentences.en: Heat action plans, or HAPs, have been proliferating in India in the past few years.
sentences.zh: 过去几年，高温行动计划（HAPs）在印度各地迅速增加。

segments.text: Heat action plans, or HAPs, have been proliferating in India in the past few years.

sentences.en: In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，HAP 会明确规定政府人员应在何时、以何种方式发布高温警报，并通知医院和其他机构。

segments.text: In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions.

sentences.en: Nagpur's plan, for instance, calls for hospitals to set aside “cold wards” in the summer for treating heatstroke patients, and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work on very hot days.
sentences.zh: 例如，那格浦尔的计划要求医院在夏季设置“冷病房”救治中暑患者，并建议建筑商在酷热天气让建筑工人暂停工作。

segments.text: Nagpur's plan, for instance, calls for hospitals to set aside “cold wards” in the summer for treating heatstroke patients, and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work on very hot days.

sentences.en: But implementation of existing HAPs has been uneven, according to a report from the Centre for Policy Research.
sentences.zh: 但据政策研究中心的一份报告，现有 HAP 的执行情况并不均衡。

segments.text: But implementation of existing HAPs has been uneven, according to a report from the Centre for Policy Research.

sentences.en: Many lack adequate funding, it found.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，许多计划缺乏充足资金。

segments.text: Many lack adequate funding, it found.

sentences.en: And their triggering thresholds often are not customized to the local climate.
sentences.zh: 而且，触发预警的阈值往往没有根据当地气候量身调整。

segments.text: And their triggering thresholds often are not customized to the local climate.

sentences.en: In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts.
sentences.zh: 在一些地区，仅凭白天气温偏高就足以触发预警。

segments.text: In some areas, high daytime temperatures alone might serve as an adequate trigger for alerts.

sentences.en: But in other places, nighttime temperatures or humidity might be as important a gauge of risk as daytime highs.
sentences.zh: 但在另一些地方，夜间温度或湿度在衡量风险时可能与白天最高温同样重要。

segments.text: But in other places, nighttime temperatures or humidity might be as important a gauge of risk as daytime highs.

sentences.en: Mumbai's April heatstroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings, researchers say.
sentences.zh: 研究人员表示，孟买4月发生的中暑死亡事件凸显了建立更细致、更本地化预警机制的必要性。

segments.text: Mumbai's April heatstroke deaths highlighted the need for more nuanced and localized warnings, researchers say.

sentences.en: That day's high temperature of roughly 36℃ was 1℃ shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities.
sentences.zh: 当天最高气温约36℃，比国家气象部门为沿海城市设定的热浪预警阈值低1℃。

segments.text: That day's high temperature of roughly 36℃ was 1℃ shy of the heat wave alert threshold for coastal cities set by national meteorological authorities.

sentences.en: But the effects of the heat were amplified by humidity—an often neglected factor in heat alert systems—and the lack of shade at the late-morning outdoor ceremony.
sentences.zh: 但湿度——高温预警系统中经常被忽视的因素——以及上午较晚时段户外活动缺乏遮阴，都放大了高温的影响。

segments.text: But the effects of the heat were amplified by humidity—an often neglected factor in heat alert systems—and the lack of shade at the late-morning outdoor ceremony.

sentences.en: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.
sentences.zh: 为改进 HAP，城市规划师 Rajashree Kotharkar 的团队正在制定一套示范方案，概括最佳实践，并可根据当地情况调整。

segments.text: To help improve HAPs, urban planner Rajashree Kotharkar's team is working on a model plan that outlines best practices and could be adapted to local conditions.

sentences.en: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.
sentences.zh: 她表示，各城市至少都应绘制一张脆弱性地图，以便把应对措施集中到风险最高的人群。

segments.text: Among other things, she says, all cities should create a vulnerability map to help focus responses on the populations most at risk.

sentences.en: Such mapping doesn't need to be complex, Kotharkar says.
sentences.zh: Kotharkar 说，这种绘图不必很复杂。

segments.text: Such mapping doesn't need to be complex, Kotharkar says.

sentences.en: “A useful map can be created by looking at even a few key parameters.”
sentences.zh: “哪怕只看几个关键参数，也能绘制出一张有用的地图。”

segments.text: “A useful map can be created by looking at even a few key parameters.”

sentences.en: For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers.
sentences.zh: 例如，老年人口较多的社区，或那些简易住房较多、难以应对高温的地区，可以获得特别预警或增设降温中心。

segments.text: For example, neighborhoods with a large elderly population or informal dwellings that cope poorly with heat could get special warnings or be bolstered with cooling centers.

sentences.en: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
sentences.zh: 那格浦尔项目已经绘制了风险与脆弱性地图，因此 Kotharkar 能告诉官员，今年夏季一旦出现热浪，应重点关注哪些社区。

segments.text: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.

sentences.en: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.
sentences.zh: 研究人员认为，HAP 不应只包含短期应急措施，还应提出能够让社区更凉爽的中长期方案。

segments.text: HAPs shouldn't just include short-term emergency responses, researchers say, but also recommend medium- to long-term measures that could make communities cooler.

sentences.en: In Nagpur, for example, Kotharkar's team has been able to advise city officials about where to plant trees to provide shade.
sentences.zh: 例如在那格浦尔，Kotharkar 的团队已经能够建议市政府应在哪里植树以提供遮阴。

segments.text: In Nagpur, for example, Kotharkar's team has been able to advise city officials about where to plant trees to provide shade.

sentences.en: HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations.
sentences.zh: HAP 还可以指导住宅改造或建筑法规调整。

segments.text: HAPs could also guide efforts to retrofit homes or modify building regulations.

sentences.en: “Reducing deaths in an emergency is good target to have, but it’s the lowest target,” says climate researcher Chandni Singh.
sentences.zh: 气候研究人员 Chandni Singh 说：“在紧急情况下减少死亡当然是一个值得追求的目标，但那只是最低层次的目标。”

segments.text: “Reducing deaths in an emergency is good target to have, but it’s the lowest target,” says climate researcher Chandni Singh.
